## Description

Proposed quantum-inspired approach to leveraged-ETF exposure rebalancing: Adjust exposure to maintain a specified leveraged-ETF allocation or target exposure, while accounting for daily-reset effects, path dependency, and transaction costs. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
